newsitem.title: FRANCE: Eurotunnel says no financial impact from fire.
newsitem.headline: Eurotunnel says no financial impact from fire.

text.p: Eurotunnel co-chairman Patrick Ponsolle said on Wednesday Eurotunnel would feel no financial pressure from a fire which forced the tunnel to close temporarily because it has ample insurance coverage.
"We are under no financial pressure because we have insurance which covers our operating losses," Ponsolle told Europe 1 radio.
Ponsolle said the loss or earnings from the fire could be "significant" but did not give a figure.
The maximum coverage of Eurotunnel's insurance is 1.5 billion francs ($290 million) for equipment and 4.5 billion for earnings loss, Ponsolle said.
"We are covered by a very, very, very large margin," Ponsolle said.

He said the train which was destroyed in the fire was worth a little less than 100 million francs and that the repair work would cost between 200 million and 500 million francs. ($ = 5.171 French Francs)
